content.what_it_is: Fortran source defining MIXING_STUFF (L52-L69), which gates a call to CALCULATE_MEAN on time >= STEADY_TIME (L59-L66), and CALCULATE_MEAN (L83-L240), which accumulates elevation, velocity, and vorticity moments, emits mean/variance-derived wave and vorticity fields at separate time intervals, detects upward mean-level crossings for per-wave extrema, and invokes preview routines at the interval boundaries (L119-L186, L200-L238).

unresolved: Use-before-definition: T_sum and T_sumUVmean are declared INTENT(OUT) at L103, but their incoming values are read on the right-hand sides of T_sum=T_sum+DT and T_sumUVmean=T_sumUVmean+DT at L116-L117. Fortran makes an INTENT(OUT) dummy undefined on entry, so both accumulation clocks start from undefined values unless the interface intent is corrected.

The sample-variance formulas divide by NumDT1-1 at L127-L128 and NumDT2-1 at L212-L213, but their interval branches at L119 and L200 have no guard requiring either counter to exceed 1; the only explicit count resets are to zero at L134 and L223, so short/zero intervals can reach a zero or negative denominator.

SQRT is applied directly to cancellation-prone expanded variances at L131 and L214 without clamping or checking for a small negative roundoff result, which can produce invalid values even when the intended variance is nonnegative.
